# Paper Sky

The market, one paper chapter a day. Real keyless market data, ELI5 explanations, an honest simulated ledger, and a humorous Sky note that is never a signal. Paper trading only — no real orders, no investment advice.

## Entry points
- / — today's board: five measurements, verdict, ledger, news, tomorrow hook
- /journal/2026-11-25/ — chapter 1, full analysis
- /notes/rsi/ — RSI: oversold is a condition, not a trigger
- /notes/rwa/ — tokenised real-world assets and what RWA TVL actually measures
- /notes/funding/ — perpetual funding and crowded positioning
- /notes/dxy/ — the dollar backpack
- /notes/fear-greed/ — mood ring, not compass
- /methodology/ — data sources, risk rules, cookies
- /archive/ — all chapters
- /rss.xml — feed
